int-commutes:
(set-option :timeout 5000)
(declare-const a Int)
(declare-const b Int)
(assert (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) a) (<= a 9007199254740991)))
(assert (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) b) (<= b 9007199254740991)))
(define-fun v1 () Int (+ a b))
(define-fun v2 () Int (+ b a))
(assert (or (not (= v1 v2)) (not true)))
(check-sat)
int-define-fun-ite:
(set-option :timeout 5000)
(declare-const a Int)
(assert (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) a) (<= a 9007199254740991)))
(define-fun m () Int (ite (< a 0) (- a) a))
(define-fun ok () Bool (>= m 0))
(assert (or (not ok) (not (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) m) (<= m 9007199254740991)))))
(check-sat)
bigint-div:
(set-option :timeout 5000)
(declare-const a Int)
(define-fun twice () Int (* 2 a))
(assert (not (= (div twice 2) a)))
(check-sat)
boolean-commutes:
(set-option :timeout 5000)
(declare-const a Bool)
(declare-const b Bool)
(define-fun l () Bool (and a b))
(define-fun r () Bool (and b a))
(assert (or (not (= l r)) (not true)))
(check-sat)
int-max:
(set-option :timeout 5000)
(declare-const a Int)
(declare-const b Int)
(assert (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) a) (<= a 9007199254740991)))
(assert (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) b) (<= b 9007199254740991)))
(assert (or (not (>= (ite (> a b) a b) a)) (not true)))
(check-sat)
int-clamp:
(set-option :timeout 5000)
(declare-const a Int)
(assert (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) a) (<= a 9007199254740991)))
(assert (or (not (and (>= (ite (< a 0) 0 (ite (> a 10) 10 a)) 0) (<= (ite (< a 0) 0 (ite (> a 10) 10 a)) 10))) (not true)))
(check-sat)
int-abs:
(set-option :timeout 5000)
(declare-const a Int)
(assert (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) a) (<= a 9007199254740991)))
(assert (or (not (>= (ite (< a 0) (- a) a) 0)) (not true)))
(check-sat)
